objective: Frozen computation: grow the 10 starts with W = y^2(1 + y), refine junction kinds from local labels by neighbours' kinds, and test whether one finite kind matrix (each junction shared among its parents) reproduces every round's counts and holds the counts' recurrence factors; controls from the catalogue and the corrected W table.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (3 of 5 held as scored, the 2 misses start rounds; referee pending): in all 30 starts (the ten y^2(1+y) break-shape eddies, fifteen y^4(1+y)^2 controls, the catalogue's five) the out-shares and the coarsest exact transfer's classes grow without settling, so no finite partition of junctions carries an exact transfer; c(t) = c(t-2) + c(t-3) fits the ancestry as a perfect matching at every recurrent round (10 of 10), saturating in the catalogue (5 of 5), though a degree-preserving shuffle pairs off too (narrowed by NATIVE-SPINE); no set of up to 3 of the 10 most frequent interval types is a native spine (0 of 10).
title: Kinds of junction on the true plastic-number eddies
